captions.text: Kennedy Space Center, Pad 39B - SLS rocket, 98 m tall
T-6 s: the four RS-25 engines start
T-0: both solid rocket boosters light - liftoff!
Faster than sound after about a minute (shown 19x faster)
T+2 min 12 s: boosters drop away, about 47 km up
T+3 min 11 s: the launch abort tower is jettisoned
